paper_metadata.title: Effect of Mo on mechanical properties and microstructure of Nb–Ti–C alloys

evidence.quote: The microstructures and mechanical properties of Nb–Ti–C alloys containing different Mo contents have been investigated.
Three alloys with nominal compositions Nb20Ti12.5C, Nb20Ti12.5C10Mo and Nb20Ti12.5C20Mo (at.%) were prepared by arc-melting and casting into buttons.

However, no secondary (small needle-like) carbide was observed in the alloys with Mo. This suggests that Mo restrains the precipitation of secondary carbide via modification of the solubility limit of carbon in Nb or/and of the kinetics of precipitation of the carbide.
